- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:333-357 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `check_pr()` returns before disabling pending auto-merge when a protected PR is blocked for a reason other than “comments were not read,” including a head mismatch.
  WHY: A pending auto-merge can remain active after the wrapper refuses the merge attempt; severity differed (MAJOR from minimax_minimax-m3, BLOCKER from openai_gpt-6-luna), so the highest severity is used.
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py::_turn_off_auto_merge() | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If disabling auto-merge fails after its retries, the gate still blocks the current merge command while the pending auto-merge can remain active, and the wrapper’s warning does not make that failure clear.
  WHY: GitHub can independently complete the pending auto-merge after checks pass, while an operator reading the refusal may not know the disable failed.
- tests/test_protected_path_authorization.py::test_check_pr_head_mismatch_leaves_auto_merge_alone | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts that a head-mismatch block leaves auto-merge alone, codifying behavior contrary to the documented disable-on-refusal contract.
  WHY: A future fix that disables auto-merge on this path would fail this test.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:345 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The “Resolve workflow support ref” step reads the branches API without retrying rate-limit failures.
  WHY: The supplied review / gate run shows an HTTP 403 rate-limit failure, and `set -euo pipefail` causes the step to terminate before support staging.
